description: Land Acquisition - Nallahena, Beruwala D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of a specific parcel of land (0.0230 Hectare, Lot No. 1) for a public purpose. It provides a detailed legal description of the property, including its location, boundaries, and the names of claimants. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition procedures, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification for land and property-related matters.
